description: This file defines classes and functions related to Chrome's trust store, including data structures for root certificates and trust store management, as well as functions to access Chrome root store version and anchors.

classes.name: ChromeRootCertInfo
classes.description: Holds DER-encoded root certificate data as a span of bytes.

classes.name: ChromeRootStoreData
classes.description: Container class storing Chrome root certificates and version info.

classes.name: TrustStoreChrome
classes.description: Manages Chrome's trust store, either using the built-in store or custom certificates.

methods.name: CreateChromeRootStoreData
methods.description: Creates a ChromeRootStoreData object from a proto, returns nullopt if errors occur.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome()
methods.description: Default constructor that uses the compiled-in Chrome Root Store.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome(const ChromeRootStoreData& anchors)
methods.description: Constructor that uses provided anchors as the trust store.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Determines trust level for a given certificate.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is in the trust store.
